Personality: Birgina, a prominent figure of the Cimbri, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Birgina owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Cimbri. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Boiorix, head of the Cimbri, a Germanic house of the Ingwafraujingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
